landing.hero.badge: WCAG 2.1 AA Compliant • Finnish Accessibility Certified
landing.hero.title: Education for Everyone, Accessible by Design
landing.hero.subtitle: The world's first fully inclusive learning management system. Built with accessibility at its core, ensuring every student can learn, participate, and succeed regardless of their abilities.
landing.features.title: Accessibility-First Features
landing.features.wcag.title: WCAG 2.1 AA Compliant
landing.features.wcag.description: Full accessibility compliance ensuring education is available to everyone, regardless of abilities.
landing.features.visual.title: Visual Accessibility
landing.features.visual.description: High contrast mode, customizable fonts, color-blind friendly interface, and screen reader optimization.
landing.features.audio.title: Audio Support
landing.features.audio.description: Text-to-speech, audio descriptions, captions, and visual alerts for comprehensive audio accessibility.
landing.features.cognitive.title: Cognitive Support
landing.features.cognitive.description: Simplified navigation, focus indicators, reading aids, and customizable learning pace for cognitive accessibility.
landing.features.motor.title: Motor Accessibility
landing.features.motor.description: Keyboard navigation, voice commands, customizable interface, and alternative input methods.
landing.mission.title: Our Mission & Vision
landing.mission.subtitle: Building the future of inclusive education through strategic phases
landing.mission.year1.title: Year 1 (2025–2026) – Validation & Foundation
landing.mission.year1.mission: Prove that AI-powered sign language avatars and accessibility tools work in real classrooms.
landing.mission.year1.point2: Partner with one NGO to test inclusivity at community events.
landing.mission.year1.point3: Build the core FinSL dataset with teachers and Deaf community contributors.
landing.mission.year2.title: Year 2 (2026–2027) – Expansion & Early Revenue
landing.mission.year2.mission: Show that LearnInclusive can scale beyond Finland and begin generating revenue.
landing.mission.year2.point1: Enter German schools with German Sign Language support.
landing.mission.year2.point4: Partner with media/education content providers for FinSL accessibility.
landing.mission.year3.title: Year 3 (2027–2028) – Innovation & Nordic Scale
landing.mission.year3.mission: Become the leading accessibility-first EdTech platform in Northern Europe.
landing.mission.year3.point1: Expand to Sweden, Norway, and Denmark.
landing.mission.year3.point2: Pilot sign-to-sign translation technology (FinSL ↔ GSL ↔ ISL).
landing.mission.year3.point3: Sign 10–15 long-term contracts with schools across Finland and Germany.
landing.mission.year4.title: Year 4 (2028–2029) – System-Wide Adoption
landing.mission.year4.mission: Achieve full adoption in Finland and Germany and secure recognition as a European leader.
landing.mission.year4.point2: Become the default compliance solution for municipalities under the EU Accessibility Act 2025.
landing.mission.year4.point3: Expand accessibility features to low-vision and multilingual learners.
landing.mission.framework: Our strategic framework builds from validation through scalability to market leadership, positioning learninclusive as the definitive accessibility-first solution in European education.
